'''2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe The MACHINE KILLA''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 4–0 at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]. The description says: "the deck i use at day 2 going 4-0" (2000 Decipher World Championship, DecipherCon 2000, 5–7 October 2000; Lapointe finished 2nd overall). Decipher Deck Designs published a different Mind What You Have Learned list for his Final Confrontation ([[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe LS]]).<ref name="dt-11037">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11037 The MACHINE KILLA], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 10 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11037/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11037/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018111258/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11037/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
